title: "Inference"
format: html

Group: Lena Cole, Mark Patzkowsky, Joel Koelewijn, Stephan Spiekman, Charlotte Summers, Emilia Jarochowska

Goal:

Infer tree and evolutionary rates across mass extinction events associated with niche shifts, taking into account availability of the niche space changing across time.
Specific case studies:

1. Reptiles across the P/T boundary: did the shift from marine to terrestrial occur once or twice (Sauropterygians and Ichthyosaurs or their common ancestor) and when?

2. Crinoids across the end-Ordovician mass extinction: what was the timing of the post-extinction radiation and is its appearance only after the extinction event an artefact of the rock-record bias?

Tools: https://revbayes.github.io/tutorials/sse/fossils
